analyst.summary: Electronics Mart India is South India's largest consumer-electronics retailer. FY26 revenue grew only 2% while net profit fell 33%, reflecting intense price competition from other large-format retailers and e-commerce discounting in a structurally thin-margin category. Return on equity and capital have both been declining, and promoter holding has fallen from 78% to 65% over three years. At roughly 48-50 times earnings, the stock is priced well ahead of its demonstrated growth and profitability trend, and we rate it a Sell.
